reasoning_content:
Clean state, 5.8GB free, ports.json matches nginx.conf. Now let me re-render via `just up --detach --no-seed` to be 100% sure nginx.conf and ports.json are consistent (it reuses the stored ports if free), then start all three sequentially. Actually, `just up --detach` calls resolveDevServerPorts which reuses stored ports if they're free — 38489/45423/43781 are all free now, so it keeps them. Good.

Let me re-render to be safe, then start sequentially: app, then cms, then boards, checking memory between each.

Actually, to avoid ANY port drift, let me NOT re-run `just up --detach` (which re-resolves ports). The nginx.conf from the last `just up --detach` already matches ports {app:38489, cms:45423, boards:43781}, and I just restored ports.json to exactly those. So they're consistent. I can go straight to starting the dev servers sequentially.

Let me start app first.
